summary: Frontend-only verification of new features: (1) direct image upload widgets replacing URL inputs in AdminProducts/AdminBanners/AdminCategoryGrid/AdminSettings, (2) header logo upload, (3) FullShop section on home, (4) Shopee-orange theme (#EE4D2D). All 6 features verified working end-to-end via Playwright at 430x900 viewport.

test_results.admin_banners_image_upload: PASS — 3 ImageUpload widgets present, upload works, save toast 'Banners saved — live on homepage'
test_results.admin_category_icons_image_upload: PASS — 8 ImageUpload widgets present; upload + save-categories succeeded
test_results.admin_settings_logo_upload: PASS — logo replaced with ImageUpload widget; setting-logo text input absent; upload + save succeeded

test_results.full_shop_section: PASS — 8 fullshop-product-<id> cards + fullshop-see-all link navigates to /shop

critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.jsx line 47-48: text-shadow still uses rgba(255,106,0,...) (old orange). Cosmetic — should update to rgba(238,77,45,...) for consistency with new theme.
ImageUpload.jsx stores the full absolute URL (${BACKEND}/api/files/...) in the field value. Works, but storing relative /api/files path would be more portable across environments (public URL change).
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a tiny 10x10 orange PNG (/tmp/testimg.png) to product/banner/category/logo storage during test — cosmetic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 requested features work. Splash dismissed by clicking [data-testid=splash-screen]. Admin login redirects to /admin. ImageUpload widget uses data-testid=image-upload/-input/-btn. Uploaded logo now appears in header.
